dialogue.text: I was going to meet Emma at the station at three, but her train is delayed.
So will you meet her at four instead?
Actually, she asked me to meet her at the library at half past four.

questions.question: Where will the man meet Emma?

dialogue.text: The museum ticket is twelve dollars, but students only pay eight.
Good. I will bring my student card, then.

questions.question: How much will the man pay?
